highlights: Blue light messes with your sleep. Studies show that blocking it two hours before bed can help you fall asleep up to 20% faster.
Total darkness = better melatonin. NASA found that a fully dark room boosts your natural sleep hormone by 40%.
Temperature matters. Lowering your body temp by just 1–2°C helps you drift off 30% quicker.
Start small. Try 1–2 tools first — like a sleep mask and white noise — and build your perfect sleep setup step by step.

blocks.text: Blue-Light Blocking Glasses

All the screens around us produce a specific light spectrum that prevents us from relaxing and puts additional strain on our eyes. According to a study published in the Journal of Adolescent Health, using these glasses two hours before bed improves sleep latency by 15-20%. A few hours before bed, it’s best to switch to night mode on your smartphone and use special glasses that block this spectrum of light, as it interferes with melatonin production.

**We recommend** : BluBlox Sleep. They filter 100% of % blue and green spectrum, have a lightweight frame, and an anti-reflective coating. The glasses improve sleep quality, reduce eye fatigue, and prevent headaches. The price is about $95-150.

Sleep Mask

This sleeping tech is quite common for most of us. Masks blackout ambient light and trigger your body to produce melatonin. This hormone is responsible for our circadian rhythms and provides us with a sense of alertness in the morning.
The entire nervous system depends on melatonin. NASA research shows that complete darkness increases melatonin levels by up to 40% compared to normal lighting conditions.

**We recommend** : Manta Sleep Mask PRO. It has custom-fit, adjustable cushions and breathable fabric. It helps to block out light, reduces morning fatigue, and is also suitable for daytime sleep. The price is reasonable, about $35-50.
Complete Sleep Bundle

This is a ready-to-go kit for quality sleep. You don’t have to figure out what you need to buy, as all the products are just there. It might include an essential oil diffuser, earplugs, and even a cooling pillow. You can involve your body with different perspectives: from the nervous system to your physical position.

**We recommend** : Sleep Master Deluxe Kit by Gravity. The package includes soft-seal mask, lavender scent, hypoallergenic silicone earplugs, and a cooling pillowcase. It produces comprehensive relaxation, stress reduction, and increased depth of sleep. The price is about $130-180.
Eye Massager

Our eyes are the first to accumulate stress. They work every day, concentrating, reading, and straining. That’s why it’s so important to keep them healthy and relaxed. Eye massagers can improve microcirculation, relieve excess stress, and even tighten the skin by toning the area around the eyes. According to the [NIH](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3220246/), heat and gentle eyelid massage stimulate the parasympathetic nervous system, speeding up the process of falling asleep. Sometimes, in addition to compression, they also feature a vibration mode, which further relaxes this area of ​​the face.

**We recommend:** RENPHO Eye Massager with Heat. It’s a soft leatherette sleep tool with temperature control from 38-42°C and Bluetooth for music. The massager reduces headaches, improves sleep, and relieves swelling. The price varies from $70 to $ 100.

Noise-Cancelling Sleep Buds

For light sleepers, earplugs can be a solution to the constant waking up due to unwanted sounds. They block out external noise and help induce deep sleep. When choosing sleep buds, it’s essential to consider their quality. They should be made of soft silicone, which won’t press against the walls of your ears and cause discomfort. Technology has advanced, and buds have also become smarter sleep items. You can now control them via Bluetooth noise cancellation and enhance your experience with special sounds like white noise or rain sounds.

**We recommend:** Bose SleepBuds. It has Bluetooth 5.0, battery life up to 10 hours, and a sleep sound library. One of the benefits is removing extraneous sounds and creating a calm background for the brain. The price varies from $200 to $250.
Orthopaedic Knee Pillow

Our body position can become severely distorted while sleeping. It causes back and neck discomfort. After such a sleep, we wake up feeling fatigued. Our joints experience noticeable discomfort. Using orthopaedic knee pillows can help with these issues. They support and stabilise the spine in a natural position, relieving excess pressure on the lower back and improving blood circulation. These pillows are typically made of memory foam, which adapts to the shape and position of the body.According to data[from the Cleveland Clinic](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/best-sleeping-positions-for-pain), correct body position during sleep reduces the risk of chronic back pain.

**We recommend:** Everlasting Comfort Knee Pillow. It has memory foam, a breathable cover, and an anatomical shape that conforms to your body. It reduces stress on the lower back and hips and improves blood circulation. The price is $35-50.
Sleep Tracker

To better understand your sleep and tailor it to your individual needs, use a specialised sleep analysis device. They offer highly accurate heart rate, respiration, and blood oxygen levels thanks to their highly sensitive sensors.[Several studies](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S1389945724000200)have confirmed a 76-84% agreement between Oura data and laboratory polysomnography.

**We recommend:** Oura Ring Gen 3. The features include sleep phase analysis, HRV, body temperature, SpO2, and cycle alarm. Also, it offers advantages such as accurate data, battery life of up to 7 days, and water resistance. Price starts from $200 to $400.

Weighted Blanket

This blanket allows our brain to sense a state of safety and calm. The mechanism of these products for sleeping is similar to swaddling a baby: gentle pressure relaxes the body. The effect, known as deep tactile pressure, reduces blood levels of cortisol, the stress hormone. It also increases the sleep hormones serotonin and melatonin. A clinical[study](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/32536366/)found that using a weighted blanket reduced insomnia in adults.

**We recommend:** Gravity Weighted Blanket. It featured micro glass beads, even weight distribution, and soft velour. The blanket improves sleep quality and reduces cortisol levels. The price is $150-250.
White Noise Machine

This tool has special frequencies that mute other environmental voices. White noise blocks them, as if protecting you from unexpected sounds. This sleep technology helps the brain relax and release stress accumulated during the day.[According to data](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S1389945721002021)from Matthew R. Ebben,Peter Yan,Ana C. Krieger, sound machines reduce the time it takes to fall asleep and improve the quality of deep sleep in people with increased anxiety.

**We recommend:** LectroFan Classic. The system counts 10 sounds of white and pink noise, a timer, and has a compact body. It helps you fall asleep even in the presence of external noise and will be especially useful in cities. The price is quite reasonable $35-45.
Sunrise Alarm Clock

This gadget simulates sunrise. It triggers the body’s natural wake-up processes. You can adjust even cortisol and serotonin production with a sunrise alarm. You wake up without a loud sound, which keeps your body stress-free. ResearchJournal of Sleep Disorders & Therapyshows that light alarms help reduce morning sleepiness and improve mood in 75% of users.
**We recommend:** Philips SmartSleep HF3520. Smart clocks have 20 brightness levels, nature sound, and sunset function. It improves morning mood and reduces stress. The price is about $130-160.

Smart Bed Frame

These are special systems that change your body position during sleep. They adapt to your needs and help make sleep more comfortable. These frames can be raised or lowered and are also heated. They ensure improved blood circulation and deeper sleep. According to the data from the SleepFoundation, ergonomic beds with adaptive controls help people with sleep apnea, back pain, and circulatory problems.

**We recommend:** Sleep Number 360 Smart Bed. The features include automatic firmness adjustment, heating, and an anti-snoring function. The bed has individual adjustments to the sleeper that improve blood circulation. Price starts from $2500 to $5000.
Bed Cooling/Heating Sleep System

Room temperature during sleep is a key factor in healthy sleep, as our bodies are susceptible to cold and heat. These systems monitor body temperature and help maintain a balance between it and the surrounding environment. A study by the Sleep Foundation found that lowering your body temperature by 1-2°C speeds up sleep by 30%.

**We recommend:** Eight Sleep Pod 3 Cover. The temperature ranges 12-43°C. The cover has app control and is compatible with any mattress. It reduces night awakenings and increases morning energy. The cover is not the cheapest, starting at $2200, but it is worth your attention.

Wearable Vagus Nerve Stimulator

Chronic stress and an overactive sympathetic nervous system are among the most common reasons people struggle to fall asleep. Wearable vagus nerve stimulators are designed to activate the parasympathetic (“rest and digest”) response, helping the body transition into a more relaxed state before bedtime. Early clinical studiessuggest that non-invasive vagus nerve stimulation may improve sleep quality, reduce stress, and increase heart rate variability, although more large-scale research is still needed.

**We recommend:** [Nuropod](https://www.biohackers.world/shop/nuropod). This wearable vagus nerve stimulator clips comfortably to the ear and delivers gentle electrical stimulation through the auricular branch of the vagus nerve. The companion app allows users to follow guided sessions and track progress. Reported benefits include improved relaxation, better sleep quality, reduced stress, and enhanced recovery. The device typically costs around **$700–900** , depending on the region and current offers.
How We Chose Sleep Tech Products

There is always something new in the [biohacking device](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/top-biohacking-devices) world. And sometimes it’s hard to understand which one can be useful for real and which of them just had a good PR campaign. That’s why our experts created a list of tips. It will help you navigate the market and understand which ones are worth paying attention to.

items: Effectiveness. If a device doesn’t produce any results, don’t waste your money on it. Choose only those sleeping gadgets whose effectiveness is scientifically proven.

User reviews. Real people who have already tried the device will speak louder than any advertisement. Consider sites like Reddit and Amazon. You can also watch reviews on YouTube. All these platforms will help you form an objective opinion.

Value for money. Sometimes we overpay simply for a brand name because it’s well-known or has invested heavily in marketing. But this isn’t the primary factor when choosing a product. It’s better to consider the device’s functionality and the quality of its materials.

Safety and certification. Devices must be FDA, CE, or ISO safety compliant. There are biohacking gadgets on the market that lack these certifications, yet are widely advertised and go viral thanks to native advertising. Be vigilant and verify the information before purchasing.

blocks.text: Summary

As you can see, there are truly a plethora of sleep-improving gadgets. Each one can help you overcome insomnia, regulate your circadian rhythms, and improve your hormonal balance. We analysed both simple insomnia devices and more advanced options. We also learned about the best sleeping tools you must have, such as the Sleep Mask Manta PRO, Bose SleepBuds II, and Eight Sleep Pod 3. These devices truly improve sleep quality, as proven by both research and user reviews.
Let’s summarise with some tips on choosing devices for quality sleep.

items: Start with 1-2 devices to avoid overloading yourself.
Combine light and sound. For example, use a sleep mask with white noise.
Ventilate the room before going to bed and try to keep the room temperature at an average level for deep sleep.
Turn off screens with blue light an hour before bed, as they interfere with melatonin production.

blocks.text: Just to note the warning, all recommendations in the article are on the medical ones! Before using new devices, please consult with your doctor. Be aware about your chronic diseases if you have any and how safe it is to use a particular gadget in such circumstances.
